head: a01d0d82dd2ea341b4f946025a85327d8973d85f
premise: At a critical nonterminal CNF parent G of rank k, each cofactor is first terminally dispatched; every surviving nonterminal child has maximum deficiency at most k-1.

terminal_dispatch.one_UNSAT_one_nonterminal: continue with the nonterminal child; no merge
terminal_dispatch.both_nonterminal: only this case invokes the missing OR-merge

required_operator.exact_semantics: SAT(M(G0,G1)) iff SAT(G0) or SAT(G1) for two nonterminal children
required_operator.rank: merge output Q is terminal or CNF with delta*(Q)<=k-1
required_operator.work: fixed N^b per-macrostep charged work for original input size N, exponent b independent of k
required_operator.state: fixed N^a live-state plus replay/merge metadata envelope, exponent a independent of k
required_operator.replay: polynomial lifting through merge and parent branch split
required_operator.closure: exact Norm returns terminal or next critical CNF G' with delta*(G')<=delta*(Q)<=k-1 and preserves the N^a/N^b envelopes

if_proved: Initial critical rank is at most the N^a clause/state envelope. Every nonterminal macrostep lowers rank by at least one, so at most N^a macrosteps with N^b per-step work give a polynomial SAT decider, hence P=NP.
review_repairs: terminal children are exceptions to branchwise rank descent and are handled before merge
normalization is explicitly forbidden from increasing maximum deficiency
polynomial step bound is N^a from the state envelope, not N by default
known_failed_natural_merges: ordinary CNF Davis-Putnam merge with maxdef rebound
auxiliary-free CNF projection with parity size blowup
